about: Every outside project the Darwin hooks run, pinned, so we always know where it came from (Gabriel, 2026-11-09, row 055). A tool is run at exactly this version from its official package; its code is never copied into a Darwin repo. To upgrade: read the release notes, change version and commit here, run it in one repo, then roll out.

tools.name: claude-code-log
tools.why: Reads Claude Code's own session files (~/.claude/projects/) and writes each session as Markdown and HTML: every prompt, tool call, hook message and refusal, so a person can read what the agent did and why. Chosen over the other viewers for its activity (releases monthly), its Markdown output for VS Code and its maintained search (serve).
